name: VT Sentinel
description: VirusTotal antivirus and active protection: background file scans with policy-controlled uploads, command inspection/blocking, quarantine, and persistent configuration. Registers with VTAI on first scan/lookup when no API key is configured.

apiKey.description: VirusTotal API Key (v3). Optional — without it, VT Sentinel auto-registers with VTAI for zero-config operation.

watchDirs.description: Nonempty list replaces automatically derived watcher roots. Empty/missing uses temp, Downloads/Desktop, workspace and OpenClaw code directories. Does not restrict manual or tool-result scans.

autoScan.description: Enable watcher and tool-result scans. Command enforcement is independently controlled by blockMode; manual tools remain available.

sensitiveFilePolicy.description: Policy for sensitive files (PDF, Office, unknown archives): ask = prompt each time, ask_once = prompt once and remember, always_upload = auto-upload, hash_only = never upload

semanticFilePolicy.description: Policy for instruction files (SKILL.md, HOOK.md, TOOLS.md, AGENTS.md, etc.): ask = prompt each time, ask_once = prompt once, always_upload = auto-upload, hash_only = never upload (default, privacy-safe)

notifyLevel.description: Scan notification verbosity: all, threats_only, or silent. Enforced command blocks and operational/audit logs remain visible; log_only command notices respect silent.

excludeGlobs.description: Glob patterns for files to skip during scanning (e.g., *.log, *.tmp)

blockMode.description: quarantine = block dangerous commands and blocklisted files, rename malicious auto-scan detections; block_only = block without renaming; log_only = log detections without blocking or quarantine. Does not change upload policy.

showCleanScanLogs.description: Whether to log clean scan results

configPreset.description: Preset; individual settings override it. privacy_first keeps sensitive/instruction files hash-only, but unknown high-risk files can still upload.

agentDisplayName.description: Display name for VTAI leaderboard (1-50 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9 _-]+)

agentHumanAlias.description: Human alias for VTAI (1-50 chars, no spaces)

agentBio.description: Agent description for VTAI define_your_self (1-200 chars)

agentMetadataMode.description: Registration always sends family, version and display name, plus any configured alias/email. enhanced also sends the configured bio or an OS-family/preset/auto-scan summary.
